title: Keajaiban Bukti Seungap .
intro: Kamoe meurumpok ngon sidroe tokoh nyang diselimuti kisah campur tangan ilahi. Saboh kisah beukai ajaib dan pertahanan nyang hana meu-ulang-ulang nyang meu-gema lam watee. Jeuet neubuka soe nyang geuhadapi cobaan nyang luar biasa nyoe?
clues: Lon teurimong saboh pesan ilahi nyang jeut keu lon hireuen .
Umat ​​lon mempertanyakan kesucian lon watee lon woe ngon sidroe aneuk .
Lon diyue puasa dari peugah haba seulama siat .
Saboh mata ie ngon kurma nyang peutheun ulôn watée ulôn sidang .
Tuhan lon peugot goyang bak kayee mukjizat keu lon bri raseuki .
Sidroe malaikat geupeuleumah droe bak ulôn lam rupa manusia nyang samporeuna .

verse: Then he called her from below her, 'Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream. And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.' (Maryam 19:24-25)
